what_it_does: A RuneLite plugin that estimates and ranks the relative memory usage of currently enabled plugins, displaying the results in a side panel with per-plugin unit counts and percentages. It walks each plugin's object graph via reflection (up to depth 2, restricted to the plugin's own package) and assigns rough unit costs to objects, arrays, collections, maps, Guava caches, and strings. The estimate refreshes on a configurable interval driven by ClientTick events.

description_match.summary: Manifest description ('Estimates relative memory usage of enabled plugins') aligns with the implemented behavior: a reflection-based estimator that produces relative unit counts shown in a PluginPanel. The legend explicitly tells users units are not bytes, matching the 'estimates' framing.

unsafe_operations.what: Walks every non-static field of every enabled plugin's class hierarchy and calls Field.setAccessible(true) to read private state via reflection. Limited to the plugin's own package (isOwnedType) and depth 2, so it does not traverse into RuneLite client internals or other plugins, but it still bypasses encapsulation of arbitrary third-party plugin classes loaded in the JVM.
Reads PluginDescriptor annotation via reflection to derive plugin display name. Benign metadata read.

bottom_line: Self-contained diagnostic plugin whose only notable concern is reflective field access into other enabled plugins' own-package objects, which is bounded (depth 2, owner-package only) and used purely for size estimation with no I/O, network, or filesystem activity.
